content_html:
No strong opinions here, but reminded on how my mechanical engineering undergrad batch had 1 woman in a class of 60.

This kind of critique makes me want to scream. Yes, men and women like different things. Wow, I’m so stunned that an event devoted to the building of giant rooms filled with servers was not of enormous interest to DC women. 

I remember when I was at Bitcoin 2024 someone had to point out that the line for the women’s bathroom was wildly shorter than the men’s. Right. It’s a Bitcoin conference. Men are way more into it. Is anyone outraged that quilting events don’t draw a lot of guys? Or pop-up designer events? Or Taylor Swift concerts?

Breaking news. The two sexes like different things. Can we just accept one of these days that men and women have a propensity to different topics and it’s really not a huge deal? It doesn’t mean anything important?
